theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_graph_parameter_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (r a : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → 0 ≤ a → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → (∀ v, ‖f v‖ ≤ r / 4) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall ξ r → R.mult x = 1) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → μHE[n] ((range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) \ R.measure.support) ∩ closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → (∀ (g : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ v, 0 ≤ g v) → (∀ v, g v ≤ G) → (∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (g v)) ≤ (∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (g (P (x - ξ))) ∂R.measure) + ENNReal.ofReal (G * a)) ∧ ∀ (g : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ v, |g v| ≤ G) → |(∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), g v) - (∫ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), g (P (x - ξ)) ∂R.measure)| ≤ G * (a + 2 ^ n * (∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), ∑ j : Fin k, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun v => EuclideanSpace.proj j (f v)) v‖ ^ 2))
